reason: Hypothesis A proposes a specific, testable mechanism linking nanoscale Mg-rich intermetallic precipitation to opposing effects on corrosion (increase) and oxidation (improvement), with clear predictions, a well-defined baseline, and a decisive falsification experiment, while Hypothesis B makes a less physically sound claim of reduced corrosion without addressing the well-known galvanic risks of intermetallics and lacks the same level of mechanistic specificity.
